name: Joshua
bio:
Joshua is a leader of the tribe of Ephraim, Moses' most important aide and eventual successor, first appearing in Exodus 17 — when the Amalekites attacked Israel, Moses instructed Joshua to choose men and go fight them, while Moses himself stood on the hilltop with Aaron and Hur, holding up his hands in prayer; Joshua defeated the Amalekites as a result (Exodus 17:8-13).

Joshua appears repeatedly afterward as Moses' closest attendant — accompanying him up Mount Sinai (Exodus 24:13) and keeping watch at the tabernacle (Exodus 33:11). The far more dramatic chapters of his life — as one of the twelve spies, and as the man God personally chose to succeed Moses in leading Israel into Canaan and conquering the promised land — will be told in detail in Numbers and the book of Joshua.
